title: Patch Manager (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • Experience planning, deploying, and validating patches across servers and endpoints.
  • Ability to interpret vulnerability scan results (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) and prioritize remediation.
  • Skilled at assessing patch criticality, handling exceptions, and applying compensating controls when needed.
  • Familiar with change management, maintenance windows, and ITIL-based processes.
  • Understanding of Windows/Linux systems, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and basic networking concepts.
  • Awareness of patching considerations in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Ability to generate patch compliance reports, audit evidence, and clear documentation.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback and Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Possibility of working remotely;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • Lounge;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • Coffee and varied snacks at your disposal;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase?

We are waiting for you!


We will use personal information that you have sent us to consider your application for the relevant function. By giving us your information/documents by email, you consent to Aubay Portugal treating your personal information. Your privacy is important to us. Please check our Privacy Policy, which explains how we will use and store your personal information. It also explains the rights you have regarding your information and how you can contact us for clarification of questions or requests.

description:

Somos uma consultoria especializada em Data Management, Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial , com presença global e reconhecimento do mercado. Atuamos de ponta a ponta — de estratégia e governança até a implementação e operação de soluções de Analytics, MDM, Data Platform e AI — ajudando organizações a transformar dados em valor de negócio sustentável.


Além de serviços, temos ofertas proprietárias e aceleradores (como o ApgarIA para manufatura e supply chain (produção, previsão de demanda, agentes de IA, etc.) — e um portfólio robusto de casos e parcerias tecnológicas que ampliam o impacto nos clientes.


O que Oferecemos:


  • Ambiente global com equipes em 4 continentes
  • Empresa reconhecida internacionalmente, com metodologias próprias, ofertas de AI e stack tecnológica ampla para construir soluções de alto impacto.
  • Somos certificados Great Place to Work no Brasil ,
  • Oferecemos trilhas de formação contínua e coaching de carreira ; cultura colaborativa e meritocrática.
  • Pacote competitivo (salário + variável) e benefícios, com flexibilidade e possibilidade de atuação remota/híbrida.


Local de Trabalho: São Paulo ou Porto Alegre (modelo híbrido/remoto)

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM ,Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Murex Trading (FO)
description:
Project description

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities

Consultants should be comfortable with at least one asset class (example: Commodities, FXO, FI etc) and show experience of implementation or client support.

2-4 years of experience in financial markets/IT business analysis

o2+ years of experience working with the Murex product on Trading or FO support/projects with clients

oAbility to utilize FO experience on financial derivatives and Murex software to participate in implementation and upgrade projects through build and validation phases.

oProvide high-quality support in using the Murex platform for market data management, pricing, and structuring of complex financial products within trading domain (e.g. FX derivatives, interest rates derivatives, Fixed Income etc).

- Develop test cases to troubleshoot the system, document defective use cases for fixes by developers.


Skills must have:

- Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, COM, EQD, FXD, FXMM

- 2-4 years of experience in financial markets/IT business analysis

- 2+ years of experience working with the Murex product on Trading or FO support/projects with clients

- Ability to utilize FO experience on financial derivatives and Murex software to participate in implementation and upgrade projects through build and validation phases.

- Provide high-quality support in using the Murex platform for market data management, pricing, and structuring of complex financial products within trading domain (e.g. FX derivatives, interest rates derivatives, Fixed Income etc).

- Develop test cases to troubleshoot the system, document defective use cases for fixes by developers.


Must:

- 2+ years' experience with Murex

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Strong SQL, Unix , Scripting , Sybase and Oracle skills



Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Python Developer - SR/PL
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

As a Python Developer, it is expected that the ideal candidate understands a broad range of computer science concepts and their applicability. This person can dive deeply into a wide range of technical problems, offering suggestions and feedback to their team and can also help to understand the requirements, and translate to an architectural design and help to plan and implement this solution for those requirements.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Actively support the development teams;
  • Mentor less experienced team members;
  • Drive team to innovate and deliver roadmap features with agility and high quality;
  • Digest requirements from product team and work on solutions with performance and scalability features for cloud systems;
  • Development of new features;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches by elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Participation in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, development, and testing;
  • Participation in technical discussions with customers;
  • Perform code reviews;
  • Conduct yourself as a trusted technical advisor;
  • Follow agile processes and participate actively in all development phases.


Essential Skills

  • Experience leading development teams;
  • Proficiency with development in Python versions 2 and 3;
  • Experience with pyTest;
  • Experience with Linux environments, CLI commands, Shell Script and logs;
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with GIT;
  • Experience with Github, GIT, code;
  • Knowledge of Agile development (e.g. using Scrum, Kanban, etc.).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • NETCONF/YANG.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Executivo de Vendas | Closer
description:
Sobre o G4 Educação

Somos o G4 Educação, somos A Evolução da Escola de Negócios.

O G4 é o lugar onde as pessoas trabalham duro para fazer do Brasil o país da prosperidade. O lugar que já gerou centenas de milhares de novos empregos por meio de seus alunos e que vai gerar pelo menos 1 milhão até 2030.

Encaramos o empreendedorismo como a maior ferramenta de transformação socioeconômica que existe e é através dela que faremos nossa revolução.

Estamos construindo uma nova geração, a geração que não pede, cria, que não espera, faz, que gera resultados para seus negócios e empregos para o país. A geração que celebra o sucesso das empresas e dos empresários porque entende que o sucesso dos negócios é o sucesso do Brasil.


Missão do Cargo

Estamos à procura de um Executivo de Vendas dinâmico e proativo, com experiência comprovada em negociar com founders, especialmente em vendas consultivas high ticket. Se você possui habilidades avançadas de comunicação e um talento especial para conduzir processos de vendas inbound, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Garantir uma experiência excepcional para os leads desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento da venda;
  • Realizar ligações e entrevistas com leads Inbound;
  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver oportunidades de vendas;
  • Realizar diagnósticos e demonstrações/apresentações de propostas comerciais;
  • Fazer follow-ups com oportunidades;
  • Negociar com os clientes e efetivar vendas;
  • Gerenciar o pipeline e forecast de vendas;
  • Adaptar-se facilmente a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e competitivo, onde a excelência e os resultados são reconhecidos e recompensados diariamente.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Conhecimento prático de CRM, preferencialmente HubSpot;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Tem inteligência emocional e está disposto a trabalhar em um ambiente que exige resiliência e aptidão a mudanças rápidas na operação;
  • Orientação para resultados e habilidades sólidas de negociação.


Informações Adicionais

Nós oferecemos:

Benefício flexível de R$ 1000,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios.

Saúde - Assistência Médica da Alice (sem coparticipação).

️Descanso Remunerado de 30 dias após 12 meses.

title: Sr. Business Analyst & Product Design
description:
Role Overview:


The Business Analyst – Product Designer is a key member of the design team, partnering with business stakeholders and solution architects to deliver value-added features for sales, marketing, and billing teams. While the primary focus is on Service Sales CRM solutions, this role also provides exposure to a suite of enterprise applications. The BA transforms stakeholder visions into functional features, documents requirements, and works closely with development teams to bring solutions to life.


On a typical day you will:


  • Assess business processes, system landscapes, and user pain points to recommend technical solutions and workarounds.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and functional design sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Document detailed functional design specifications (epics, features, user stories).
  • Lead refinement sessions with Scrum teams to review feature designs, estimate effort, and prepare for sprint cycles.
  • Support QA and UAT test planning, execution, and bug triage.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Santa Catarina
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Profissional Engenheiro de Dados PL- Azure Databricks
description:
Código da vaga: 55105


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Engenheiro de Dados, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Ferramentas: Azure Databricks e Azure Data Factory (suporte, manutenção e criação de pipelines/ETLs).

Linguagens: Python, SQL, PySpark.

Serviços Azure: Blob Storage, Aplicativos Web, Serviços de Contêiner.

DevOps: Vivência com práticas ágeis e integração contínua.

Catálogo de dados

Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades interpessoais e de documentação de requisitos.


Responsabilidades

Aplicar conhecimento em arquitetura de dados e sua implementação.

Desenvolver, otimizar e gerenciar pipelines de dados e ETLs.

Implementar mecanismos de segurança para acesso aos dados.

Monitorar a execução dos sistemas e pipelines.

Elaborar soluções de dados completas para os clientes.

Promover inovação e cultura de dados nas equipes.

Estabelecer e defender melhores práticas de dados.




Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

  • Conhecimento de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS).

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
About Turing



Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at



Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.

title: Consultor de Identidade e Desenvolvimento (CIAM)
description:
Sobre a vaga:

Você atuará como líder técnico(a) na implementação de soluções CIAM, conduzindo projetos complexos e garantindo que as necessidades dos clientes se traduzam em entregas robustas, seguras e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio. Será responsável por orientar equipes, apoiar o desenho de soluções e garantir alta qualidade técnica em todas as fases da implantação, influenciando diretamente o sucesso das iniciativas de identidade digital.


Responsabilidades:

✔ Liderar a implementação e implantação de soluções CIAM em múltiplos projetos simultâneos.

✔ Traduzir requisitos de clientes em fluxos técnicos acionáveis.

✔ Coletar, analisar e documentar requisitos funcionais e técnicos.

✔ Comunicar-se com stakeholders em níveis técnicos e funcionais.

✔ Gerenciar expectativas e manter relacionamento forte com clientes.

✔ Projetar e implementar soluções seguras usando plataformas CIAM líderes.

✔ Configurar integrações com aplicações, serviços externos e sistemas corporativos.

✔ Aplicar conhecimentos em protocolos de federação e controle de acesso.

✔ Desenvolver soluções personalizadas utilizando linguagens de backend e frontend.

✔ Oferecer orientação sobre melhores práticas em identidade, segurança e conformidade.

✔ Solucionar problemas técnicos complexos em ambientes cloud e on-premise.

✔ Contribuir para projetos de solução garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.

✔ Validar configurações e customizações antes da entrega ao cliente.

✔ Conduzir workshops e sessões de implementação com stakeholders.

✔ Coordenar atividades para garantir entregas dentro do prazo.

✔ Documentar soluções e manter repositórios de conhecimento.

✔ Colaborar com equipes internas e apoiar resolução de escalonamentos.

✔ Mentorar consultores menos experientes.

✔ Atuar junto à área comercial em oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.

✔ Trabalhar em engajamentos de pós-venda com foco em consultoria CIAM.

✔ Atuar como ponto de contato entre clientes e produto interno.


Requisitos:

✔ Experiência prática com Auth0, Okta, Transmit Security e Descope.

✔ Experiência em configuração e troubleshooting de plataformas CIAM.

✔ Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas em ambientes cloud e on-premise.

✔ Conhecimento aprofundado em SAML 2.0, OAuth, OpenID Connect, WS-Federation e FIDO2.

✔ Experiência com modelos de controle de acesso.

✔ Experiência em desenvolvimento de software (JavaScript, Node.js, Java, .NET, PHP, REST/JSON).

✔ Experiência com frameworks frontend (React, Angular, Vue) e mobile (iOS, Android).

✔ Capacidade de criar soluções escaláveis e de fácil manutenção.

✔ Conhecimento de processos e padrões de ciclo de vida de identidade empresarial.

✔ Capacidade de garantir entregáveis com requisitos rigorosos de segurança.

✔ Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais:

➕ Experiência com múltiplas plataformas CIAM em cenários corporativos complexos.

➕ Vivência em projetos de larga escala e ambientes multinuvem.

➕ Contribuições para comunidades ou projetos open source de identidade.

➕ Certificações em plataformas CIAM ou tecnologias de segurança.


Modelo de trabalho:

Remoto - Disponibilidade para reuniões em horário comercial dos EUA

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success,

title: Staff Product Engineer (Software)
description:
Staff Product Engineer (Software)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Compensation: $60,000 USD / year

Annual Bonus: $6,000 (10%)

Backed By: Top Silicon Valley investors — Y Combinator, Liquid 2, Founder of Instacart, Founder of Reddit

Stage: High-growth consumer health tech subscription product generating $1M/month , compounding 15% MoM

TAM: $29.4B in the U.S. (100M people). ~600M people globally.

Career Growth: As our first full-time Staff Engineer , you will set engineering standards, establish technical direction, and grow the engineering team.


About the Job

As a Staff Software Engineer on Product , you will directly shape our customer-facing web app (tens of thousands of MAU) and own our highest-priority engineering initiatives. You’ll partner closely with the Product Designer, both Founders, and lead our engineering team to build reliable software that drives customer retention and product velocity.

You’ll spend ~75% of your time writing code and ~25% on technical direction, architectural decisions, and collaborating on the product roadmap .

You will operate in a Build → Measure → Learn + Iterate product loop.


About You

  • 8+ years building full-stack applications with Python and JavaScript
  • 4+ years of production React experience
  • Able to translate Figma designs into scalable React/Python implementations
  • Strong product-growth instincts and experience with event instrumentation
  • Skilled with PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar tools
  • Exceptional communicator who builds trust, aligns teams, and drives decisions
  • Staff-level depth: setting technical direction, making architectural tradeoffs, delivering impact
  • Adept at balancing technical debt, infra cost, engineering hours, and time-to-ship
  • Comfortable in fast-paced startup environments where engineers own infra end-to-end


Our Stack

  • Python (FastAPI) — backend
  • TypeScript (React) — frontend
  • Postgres (Supabase)
  • PostHog for product analytics
  • AWS
  • GitHub


What You’ll Do1. Build

  • Work with the Product Designer and Founders to define the technical direction
  • Translate customer feedback and Figma screens into clear technical requirements
  • Break down work across yourself + 2 Full-Stack Engineers + 1 AI Engineer
  • Own architecture, core features, and high-quality implementation
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the codebase

2. Measure

  • Instrument all necessary customer events inside our web app
  • Ensure PostHog receives clean, reliable data for evaluating retention and feature impact

3. Learn + Iterate

  • Partner with the Product Designer and CTO to build charts/dashboards in PostHog
  • Extract insights quickly to inform product decisions
  • Ship iterations rapidly and maintain a fast learning cycle

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

title: Backend Developer (JAVA) #986218
description:
Who We Are

DEXIAN, launched in 2023, has a global presence and brings with it nearly 30 years of experience through its legacy companies, primarily from the combination of DISYS and Signature Consultants.

We began operating in Brazil in 2007 as DISYS and, since then, we have earned the trust of more than 60 clients across different sectors of the economy. As DEXIAN, we have become one of the leading companies in staffing solutions, IT solutions, and workforce augmentation.

We are leading the industry through the delivery of exclusive services that combine global scale, full-service project capabilities, and tactical agility to modernize hiring models. We support our clients in finding the best way to address their talent gaps in order to drive their digital transformation.

We have offices strategically located in four major cities: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ), and São Paulo (SP). This allows us to remain close to our clients and consultants. We are also a Minority-Owned Company and are proud to have been born from diversity.


What to Expect From Us

People are at the core of our strategy and represent our greatest asset. We are committed to attracting and retaining top talent and building meaningful, long-lasting connections. That’s why we act as a bridge between highly qualified professionals and consistent, prosperous opportunities.

We believe that bringing the right talent, technology, and organizations together helps unlock transformative outcomes and achieve new levels of success for the clients we serve and the consultants we hire.

To guide us, we rely on five core values: Integrity, Transparency, Authenticity, Ingenuity, and Empathy. DEXIAN is committed to corporate social responsibility and invests in programs that support diversity and inclusion.

If you share these values, this is the place for you!


Requirements:

  • Java (JDK 8+), Spring Boot, Hibernate, and multithreading – Solid hands-on experience developing backend applications.
  • SQL & Database Management – Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle), including basic query tuning.
  • Microservices & API Development – Experience building RESTful APIs and working within a microservices-based environment.
  • Performance Optimization – Familiarity with database indexing, query optimization, caching tools (Redis, Memcached), and basic JVM tuning.
  • Cloud & DevOps – Understanding of cloud environments (preferably Azure), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Security & Best Practices – Knowledge of authentication standards (OAuth, JWT), encryption basics, and secure coding guidelines.
  • System Design & Scalability – Understanding of distributed systems concepts, message queues, and applications that require high availability.
  • Collaboration & Communication – Ability to work collaboratively with Development, Operations, and QA teams.
  • Version Control – Strong experience with Git commands (clone, commit, push, pull, branching) and working with GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repositories.


Language: Advanced/Fluent English – Required.


Brazilian Time (BRT) from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m . This schedule was chosen to allow for more hours of interaction with the team working in Central European Time (CET).

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Java – Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora Backend com sólida experiência em Java e arquitetura de microserviços, que também tenha forte senso de colaboração e comunicação para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e impacto.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, busca excelência técnica, gosta de trabalhar em equipe e está sempre em busca de melhorias contínuas, essa vaga é para você!

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações backend escaláveis, performáticas e seguras, utilizando Java 8+.
  • Projetar e manter microserviços com Spring Boot, aplicando boas práticas e padrões de projeto.
  • Participar da definição e evolução de arquitetura de sistemas, com foco em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Criar, manter e consumir APIs RESTful seguras e eficientes.
  • Atuar em pipelines de CI/CD, automação e deploy com ferramentas como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, etc).
  • Colaborar com as equipes de QA, DevOps e outros desenvolvedores em revisões de código e definições técnicas.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos sistemas existentes, priorizando performance e manutenibilidade.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente colegas de equipe, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java (Java 8+).
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços e uso de Spring Boot.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem pública (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com containers (Docker) e orquestração com Kubernetes.
  • Prática com CI/CD e automação de deploys.
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e cultura de qualidade de código.
  • Boa comunicação para interações com times técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe, senso de ownership e postura colaborativa.

Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos de larga escala.
  • Certificações em nuvem ou em Java/Spring.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client building an AI-powered healthcare assistant that helps people navigate one of the most confusing, stressful areas of life: insurance, billing, and getting clear answers when you need them most.


They are early, focused, and looking for Full-Stack Engineers to help build and scale our core product from the ground up.


What You’ll Do

  • Own major features end-to-end — design → build → deploy
  • Build across the full stack: React/Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL
  • Work directly with the founders on product direction & architecture
  • Shape our early engineering culture, tools, and best practices
  • Build intuitive UIs and AI-driven workflows


Who You Are

  • ~5+ years building and shipping production-grade software
  • Strong with React/Next.js (React Native is a nice bonus)
  • Experienced with Python on the backend
  • Comfortable with PostgreSQL
  • A builder who enjoys solving problems, not just following specs
  • Familiar with AI tools and uses them to boost productivity
  • Thrives in a small, fast-moving startup environment
  • Balances speed with quality and cares deeply about doing right by users

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Specialist will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

Job Summary: The Sales Specialist will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory

title: Scrum Master SR
description:
Buscamos um(a) Scrum Master Sênior para atuar na criação de cadência para o time, promovendo entregas constantes com agilidade e foco em melhoria contínua dos processos. Você será facilitador(a) do fluxo de trabalho, parceiro(a) de PO e engenharia, e referência em cultura ágil orientada a valor e métricas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Estabelecer e sustentar a cadência do time, facilitando rituais e garantindo fluxo de trabalho.
  • Promover entregas constantes com agilidade, orientando por métricas (lead time, throughput, WIP, CFD) e foco em valor.
  • Conduzir melhoria contínua, ajustando processos e eliminando desperdícios.
  • Antecipar e remover impedimentos/dependências, alinhando PO, times técnicos e stakeholders e fortalecendo um ambiente de alta performance.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Scrum Master em produtos/tecnologia.
  • Domínio de Scrum e Kanban, técnicas de facilitação, gestão de fluxo e métricas ágeis; vivência em discovery e delivery.
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação, influência sem autoridade, mediação de conflitos e coaching de times.
  • Prática com ferramentas como Jira/Confluence e Miro/Mural.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Arquiteto de Dados III
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Principais atividades:

• Desenvolvimento e Evolução de Plataformas: Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir plataformas de dados robustas e escaláveis.

• Ideação e Implementação de Arquiteturas: Liderar a ideação e implementação de novas arquiteturas de dados.

• Automação e Escalabilidade: Desenvolver pipelines de dados automatizados e escaláveis.

• Documentação e Conhecimento: Documentar processos e sistemas de forma detalhada.

• Governança e Qualidade de Dados: Implementar e monitorar práticas de governança de dados.

• Relatórios e Comunicação: Criar relatórios técnicos detalhados e apresentar para stakeholders.

• Colaboração Interdisciplinar: Trabalhar com equipes de ciência de dados e engenharia de dados para entender requisitos.

• Avaliar e incorporar novas tecnologias em conjunto com Arquitetura.

• Mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

• Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e ferramentas.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia ou área correlata.

Domina os seguintes itens:

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Ferramentas de IaC como Terraform, Plumini e CloudFormation.

• Computação em Nuvem: Experiência com AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, Redshift, EMR, Glue, Athena e SageMaker.

• Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC.

• Armazenamento e Arquitetura de Dados: Implementação de data lakehouse e estruturas Medallion.

• Modelos de Machine Learning em produção: Experiência no deploy e monitoramento de modelos.

• Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Experiência com Apache Airflow, dbt e outras ferramentas.

• Experiência com Databricks.

• Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e SQL.

• Boas Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Aplicação de princípios de engenharia de software, como controle de versão, testes automatizados, integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD).

• Governança de Dados: Experiência com políticas de governança de dados, gestão de dados sensíveis e privados, e catálogos de dados.

• Experiência em processar e gerenciar grandes volumes de dados (Terabytes).

• Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Inglês intermediário (leitura técnica).

• Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos.

• Habilidade para criar e apresentar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais.

• Visão estratégica de negócios e da necessidade dos times de dados



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

• Comunicação

• Trabalho em equipe

• Adaptabilidade

title: Test Automation/ SDET - Angular JS
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As an SDET/Test Automation Engineer, you should be able to atomate tests through use of test automation tools and through code development, interacting with Software Development team in order to complete ticket cycles, analyzing system and applications and propose test strategy, participating in technical discussions with customer, coordinating with development team to drive product quality, reporting/monitoring/verifying issues in defect tracking tool and working in a dynamic, collaborative, and transparent environment where talent is valued over a role title.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Implement automated testing frameworks, ensuring continuous integration (CI);
  • Automate tests through use of test automation tools and through code development;
  • Interact with Software Development team in order to complete ticket cycles;
  • Analyze system and applications and propose test strategy;
  • Participate in technical discussions with customer;
  • Coordinate with development team to drive product quality;
  • Report/Monitor/Verify issues in defect tracking tool (JIRA, Bugzilla, etc);
  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, and transparent environment where talent is valued over a role title.


Essential Skills

  • Advanced English;
  • Experience with Javascript for testing;
  • Knowledge of creating scripts using automated testing tools;
  • Experience with Web Applications testing tools;
  • Experience with Jira Platform.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience developing test cases/plans and ability to analyze code to identify root cause of issues;
  • Experience working with testing tools: Robot Framework / Jasmine / Cypress;
  • Experience working in an Agile / Scrum / Kanban environment;
  • Medium Linux knowledge.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Engenheiro de Software II
description:
Buscamos um Engenheiro(a) de Software II para atuar no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções corporativas do ecossistema Backoffice — abrangendo áreas como Financeiro, Fiscal, Contábil, Controladoria, Comercial e Cadastro.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas, aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software e contribuir com a evolução arquitetural das aplicações, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e integração entre sistemas.


Responsabilidades principais

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend e integrações entre sistemas corporativos.
  • Aplicar princípios de Clean Code, SOLID e Design Patterns.
  • Implementar testes automatizados e participar de code reviews.
  • Colaborar na definição de soluções arquiteturais e otimização de rotinas críticas.
  • Garantir observabilidade e estabilidade das aplicações.
  • Colaborar com POs e analistas de negócio na definição técnica de requisitos e regras de negócio.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência com Python, PHP (Laravel) ou Node.js.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora).
  • Vivência com integrações REST/SOAP, mensageria (SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ, Kafka) e ambientes cloud (AWS ou similares).
  • Experiência com Git e práticas CI/CD / DevOps.


Diferenciais

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Serverless Framework.
  • Conhecimento em SAP B1 SDK, Tax One, IDT ou sistemas fiscais/financeiros.
  • Experiência com monitoramento (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog).
  • Métodos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Perfil desejado

  • Protagonismo técnico e senso de dono.
  • Comunicação colaborativa e foco em soluções.
  • Organização e aprendizado contínuo.


Formação: Superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação e certificações técnicas são diferenciais.



Informações adicionais

Na Total Express a diversidade é um compromisso com todos os nossos colaboradores, parceiros e clientes com o objetivo de eliminar barreiras, desconstruir estereótipos, promover a igualdade de oportunidades e celebrar a riqueza de nossas diferenças. Queremos criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam confortáveis em serem autênticos e onde a diversidade seja cultivada e respeitada em todos os níveis.


O movimento faz parte da nossa identidade. E aqui na Total estamos sempre em busca de novas formas de valorizar e apoiar o crescimento dos nossos colaboradores. Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos


• Vale Refeição.

• Day off de aniversário no mês do seu aniversário.

• Plano de saúde com custo zero para o colaborador na taxa administrativa mensal, descontando apenas a coparticipação.

É extensivo a filhos, cônjuge ou companheiro (a), inclusive do mesmo sexo, com custo reduzido.

• Plano odontológico extensivo a filhos, cônjuge ou companheiro (a), inclusive do mesmo sexo.

• Seguro de vida, incluso auxílio funerário, com custo zero.

• TotalPass.

• Somos uma Empresa Cidadã, e por isso você terá direito a licenças ampliadas. Paternidade: 5 dias pela lei + 15 dias Empresa Cidadã/ Maternidade: 120 dias pela lei + 60 dias Empresa Cidadã.

• O melhor momento do ano: bônus ou PPR anual - De acordo com a politica vigente.


Além de tudo isso, você terá:

• A oportunidade de viver em um ambiente que respeitará sua personalidade, seu jeito de ser e estilo de se vestir (bermuda, tênis etc.).

• Programas de desenvolvimento profissional/educacional internos e externos.

• Participação em nossos processos seletivos internos.

• Oportunidade de nos ajudar com nossos projetos sociais.

*De acordo com a localidade da vaga e política de elegibilidade do cargo.
